name: T-nut M5 for 2020 slot (drop-in)
source: https://www.openbuilds.com/ (V-slot 2020 hardware) and Misumi HNTT5-5: slot 6 mm wide, M5 thread
notes: Drop-in T-nut for 2020 extrusion, 10 x 10 x 5 mm (z 0-5 in the slot, +z toward the screw), M5 thread at the centre. Slide it in, tighten an M5 x 10 screw until the nut turns and bites the slot lips.
